source.review_scope: Independent source/UX evidence review of the actual three-leaf Root-authored correction. Correctness reviewer1954 and conservation reviewer1281 retain their disjoint scopes. No broad watcher, layout or feature-series re-review.

user_task.intended: Search the current local checkout. After exact root retirement, old A rows/errors/completion must not become B's current search. Keep the user's query/options and resume searching the same-key replacement. Ordinary Git edits, generic rescans/polls, other roots and other projects should preserve an ongoing search.
user_task.before: The logical key and generation could survive same-path replacement, accepting delayed old Batch/Error/Finished under the replacement.
user_task.after_supported_from_source: An ingested matching exact retirement cancels the old token, clears retired results/error/cap/skipped state, advances generation and schedules the existing 75ms debounce. The same query/options/root remain. Late old progress and held activation fail existing generation checks.
user_task.readiness: Not native UX, performance or whole-feature approval.

source_flow_assessment.conclusion: Exact root Remove/Name events can add the real worktree root to retired_roots; reconciliation can observe a registered same-mode path's changed/missing identity. Coalescing retains the set. The production Changed handler actually invokes apply_git_watch_change, which retires search before queuing the ordinary Git read.
source_flow_assessment.limit: This is event/point-observation evidence. It is not a physical snapshot, a native delivery result, or a guarantee for missed/ambiguous events.

source_flow_assessment.conclusion: The retirement path does not overwrite Options, root or query_focused, nor add a focus command. It clears obsolete result/cache/count/selection/error state. Existing stable query widget ID and controls remain.
source_flow_assessment.limit: Actual caret, keyboard focus, hover, scrolling and native transitions are UNRUN. Resetting selected old row is appropriate; focus preservation is source intent, not observed native behavior.

source_flow_assessment.conclusion: Cancellation and generation increment happen synchronously at notification ingestion, before the returned future waits75ms. Old Run/progress messages fail generation checks. The timer schedules a new worker; it does not itself prove reopening or source results from B.
source_flow_assessment.limit: Repeated actual retirement messages can postpone the debounce and cause more than one restart. There is no added recurring timer or ordinary-event restart source, but cadence/stall behavior needs original event/run evidence.

source_flow_assessment.conclusion: Matching requires the same project and exact retired root. Ordinary file/metadata data changes, a retired descendant/other root, generic rescan flags and pure configuration removal do not by themselves call schedule_project_search. The added consumer controls check three such nonmatching cases.
source_flow_assessment.limit: This source assessment does not claim every native backend event classification or event burst was exercised.

source_flow_assessment.conclusion: The new generation also changes the existing row ownership key and rejects an old captured ResultTarget or Submit generation before route/open effects. Fresh rows keep their existing source-line and dirty-buffer navigation protections.
source_flow_assessment.limit: No new test exercises an actual held native pointer press or queued keyboard submit across replacement. Exact editor selection/focus remains a native gate.

source_flow_assessment.conclusion: New UI-path work is project/path-set matching and the preexisting bounded result-state retirement/scheduling. No synchronous canonicalization, stat, directory open or filesystem traversal was added there. The metadata identity observation remains in the git-watch thread.
source_flow_assessment.limit: Source placement does not establish frame/resource performance or a hard cancellation deadline.

recovery_concern.title: A replacement that is not ready at the single75ms restart can leave the unchanged query on a folder error
recovery_concern.condition: The active project/worktree/path key never passes through None, but the old root is absent when the restart opens W; B becomes valid later. This includes a Git read that fails while primary metadata is absent, leaving the prior sidebar row, or a busy/queued Git refresh that only publishes the later same-key B state.

causal_source.fact: The retirement schedules exactly one debounced run. A current-generation error sets error and running=false.
If W is still absent when Root::open runs, the real worker publishes 'Could not search this folder: ...' and returns.
A later Create of W can produce topology/membership invalidation but is not a retired_roots event.
A recovered same-key row keeps the equal-key rebind early return; an ordinary change with empty retired_roots does not restart search.
Git read failure can retain the previous row. Later successful inventory/status recovery does not explicitly resume a failed retired-root search.
If the missing original registration was already removed, later new registration has no retained old identity to report as a second retirement; it only returns rearmed ownership.
The query's Enter action opens a selected match; the error is a caption and exposes no explicit retry action.

recovery_concern.user_effect: The query text survives, but the user can remain on a transient folder error after the same-path checkout is usable. Editing a query/option or reopening Search reruns it, but the error does not communicate that recovery path.
recovery_concern.classification: The underlying error-caption/no-retry pattern is inherited. The new automatic retirement restart exposes this delayed-publication schedule; it is separate from closing the original stale-generation P2. This review did not execute the schedule and does not claim every replacement takes it.
recovery_concern.required_resolution: Before claiming the complete replacement/recovery flow, establish an explicit recovery contract and test it: either a narrow post-retirement ready/retry transition resumes the preserved query, or a clear action lets the user retry the same query. Preserve the requirement that ordinary successful searches are not restarted by generic edits/rescans/polls.
recovery_concern.root_coordination: Root accepted this recovery blocker and is authoring a minimal explicit Action::Retry plus visible keyboard-focusable Retry search control in the existing error state, preserving query/options/root. No new polling or root-ready protocol. That is an announced correction plan, not reviewed successor source or native evidence;82bb stays HOLD until the actual new freeze is reviewed.
recovery_concern.smallest_owning_oracle: In the actual app consumer fixture, retire the matching root, execute the returned75ms Run against an absent private W and accept its real current-generation folder error. Restore a valid same-key checkout, deliver the supported recovery/Create/Git read path without publishing active=None, and require the intended same-query recovery without typing, changing filters or reopening the panel. Keep the immediate-B success and ordinary/unrelated event controls. This is a focused source/worker test plus later native case, not a request for a generic retry framework.

parents.name: app::search_ui::tests::delivered_root_retirement_rejects_queued_old_progress_under_the_same_key
parents.what_it_can_establish: Calls the same apply_git_watch_change used by production; checks cancellation/generation/state clearing, rejects old Batch/Error/Finished through Application::update and accepts injected current-generation progress.

It does not await75ms, launch the real worker, read B, process real Monitor drain, demonstrate physical replacement, assert all query/filter/focus fields or cover delayed readiness/stale native click.

authored_test_evidence.source_format: Freeze attributes existing official format/diff checks to Root's recorded receipts. They are not compilation, executed test bodies or UX evidence.

minimum_native_evidence_plan.after_refresh_rule: If source changes to resolve recovery or other reviewed behavior, freeze the new actual head and refresh affected review/capture. Do not present82bb evidence as a successor pass.
minimum_native_evidence_plan.execution_authority: No runtime grant, lane, C claim, fixture execution or development-runner launch is supplied by this plan.
minimum_native_evidence_plan.app: Actual native app through scripts/run-development --browserless, with the repository's matched executable/fresh-daemon requirements when separately admitted. The behavior is local filesystem/Git work; no live agent/provider is required.
minimum_native_evidence_plan.data: Use private prepared local A/B checkout data at the same physical W and stable logical key, with distinguishable matched snippets and a fresh B result at an index previously occupied by A. Keep matched viewport, scale, theme, query/options, fixture content and event workload for before/after. No user repository/content.
minimum_native_evidence_plan.causality: Retain original watcher event/drain, search generation/cancel/Run and original progress provenance sufficient to establish notification ordering and whether output came from A or B. Physical rename plus a final screenshot alone does not prove delayed old progress was rejected. A state fixture in the running native app can qualify rendering/interaction only; label it and do not call an injected Change or result a native producer/worker pass.

states: A populated while search is running
exact retirement has been ingested: old rows cleared, preserved query/options, searching/empty transition
B populated or genuinely empty after the fresh real worker finishes
scenarios.interactions: Leave query/caret in place, hold an A row press or queued Enter across retirement, release after B reuses the index, then activate a fresh B row. Require no old opening, correct B editor selection/focus, usable scrolling and keyboard navigation.

states: old A Error/Finished queued beside retirement
W absent beyond75ms and current retry error/wait state
B restored under the same key, with the agreed visible retry/recovery result
scenarios.interactions: Do not let another query/options change, active=None interval or unrelated edit rescue the recovery observation. Old A error/cap/count must never overwrite B. Check the source-supported transient-error concern above.

states: ongoing populated Search under realistic local Git edits and one generic rescan/poll
completion of the original unchanged query
scenarios.interactions: Require no query loss, unnecessary repeated restart/blanking, stalled spinner/hover, scroll reset or late incorrect opening. Original generation/run provenance must distinguish preservation from an unnoticed restart.

minimal_visual_artifacts: Matched wide Before/After WebP pair for the affected post-retirement result state: retired A output before versus current B output after, with the state description below the pair.

Matched Before/After error/recovery pair for the delayed-ready or queued-error state actually supported by the final correction; include its intermediate empty/searching state in the interaction record.
One matched narrow affected-result/recovery pair if that layout is exercised, verifying query/filter access, readable notice, result activation and no unusable clipping.
minimum_native_evidence_plan.screenshot_delivery: Only two side-by-side columns labeled Before/After, state description underneath. Save descriptive WebP images on a separate screenshot branch under pr-screenshots and use immutable commit URLs. Check private data before publication. No images or native evidence exist from this review.
minimum_native_evidence_plan.responsiveness: Compare the same private search corpus/concurrent UI update workload at before and final after. Record first-result/restart-to-result behavior, frame stalls and relevant resource use; show ordinary event bursts do not produce a recurring search restart/stall. Existing200ms target and historical timings remain unmeasured here; no new broad performance redesign.
minimum_native_evidence_plan.independent_native_ux_review: Supply original interaction evidence, source/tested-head pins and intended flow to an independent reviewer. Source labels or unit results cannot waive the missing native path.
